title: Skeleton Keychain — Green
description: Soft PVC keychain moulded in two layers: a pink skeleton and cauliflower head set into a green body, with a raised black outline. Supplied on a nickel-plated split ring and short chain.

images.alt: Skeleton Keychain in green, with a pink skeleton and a pink cauliflower head, on a split ring

title: Skeleton Keychain — Sealed
description: The green Skeleton Keychain delivered sealed in its original polybag, unopened. For collectors who would rather it stayed that way.

images.alt: Skeleton Keychain in green sealed in its clear polybag

title: Skeleton Keychain — Blackout
description: The same moulding, worn the other way round: a flat, unprinted black face with the silhouette raised in relief. No colour, no artwork, just the shape.

images.alt: Skeleton Keychain shown from the reverse, moulded in solid black

title: Skeleton Keychain — Mono
description: The Skeleton Keychain with every colour taken out: white bones and a white cauliflower head on a grey body, black outline. Same mould, different run.

images.alt: Skeleton Keychain in monochrome, white bones on a grey body

title: Skeleton Keychain — Mono Sealed
description: The Mono Skeleton Keychain delivered sealed in its original polybag, unopened.

images.alt: Monochrome Skeleton Keychain sealed in its clear polybag

title: Skeleton Keychain — Mono Blackout
description: The Mono run seen from the reverse: an unprinted black face with the silhouette raised in relief. Sold out.

images.alt: Monochrome Skeleton Keychain shown from the reverse, unprinted black

title: Brain Pin — Yellow
description: Hard enamel pin in black metal: a yellow brain split by a pink spine, two white eyes, olive shading behind. Polished flat, with a single post and butterfly clutch.

images.alt: Brain Pin — yellow enamel brain split by a pink spine, with two white eyes, in black metal

title: Brain Pin — Carded
description: The Brain Pin mounted on its printed olive backing card and sealed, as it ships. The card is part of the release rather than packaging to throw away.

images.alt: Brain Pin mounted on its printed olive backing card, sealed in a polybag

title: Brain Pin — Backstamp
description: The Brain Pin seen from behind: the plated reverse, the post, and the butterfly clutch it ships with.

images.alt: Reverse of the Brain Pin, showing the plated back, post and butterfly clutch
